title: jumellea triquetra
intro: Jumellea triquetra, commonly known as the "Queen of the Night," is a fragrant, nocturnal orchid native to tropical regions. This plant is prized for its medicinal properties, offering a range of health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Jumellea triquetra are attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which can help regulate the nervous system and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
